# Rooms to choose from

Notes from our visits in October. All three can be booked for Sundays, 2 to 5 pm.

## St Aidan's Hall

- Cost: £48 a rehearsal
- Space: seats 45 players with music stands
- Piano: upright, tuned in the spring
- Parking: 12 spaces behind the hall
- Bus: a stop 3 minutes' walk away, every 20 minutes on Sundays
- Also: a kitchen where parents can wait with a cup of tea

## Oakfield School music room

- Cost: £35 a rehearsal, which pays for the caretaker's time
- Space: seats 36 players, a tight fit once the cellos are in
- Piano: grand piano
- Parking: none on site, street parking only
- Bus: a stop outside the gate, every 30 minutes on Sundays
- Also: the caretaker opens up at 1:30, and a locked cupboard can hold our stands

## Mill Studio

- Cost: £85 a rehearsal
- Space: seats 40 players
- Piano: digital piano
- Parking: 30 spaces
- Bus: a stop 10 minutes' walk away, hourly on Sundays
- Also: a sprung floor and microphones for recording
